# Connections

August 18, 2026

Table of contents

[How to use connections](https://support.formalize.com/en/articles/566814-connections#h_51ce7378bf)[How to add a new connection](https://support.formalize.com/en/articles/566814-connections#h_0a1ec094ac)[Common questions](https://support.formalize.com/en/articles/566814-connections#h_8d7d3e560b)

**Overview**

The Connections section in Formalize brings all resource connections together in one unified place, making it easier to understand, configure, and customize relationships between resources.

You can manage existing connections and create new ones from a single, consistent view.

* * *

# How to use connections

You are able to connect your resource to another resource by using the **Connections** section. The image below shows you the consolidated Connections section, in the detail page of a **System.**

![Screenshot 2025-09-30 at 08.08.29](https://formalize.intercom-attachments.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/100962956/11199ee22135525c5f27ac2b7300/Screenshot-202025-09-30-20at-2008_08_29.png?expires=1794341700&signature=1c69f9157a9c010e4087ddfefa290a3293d15580305901313ccddf314a99e60e&req=0dVvzF74pTIulxv889ospxMYOXHPeBJtE2c1teN5tXwxsob7OEXpgdX1v6OS%0AALDtA4LziPgTInqiYw%3D%3D%0A)

- **Connect Items**


To connect resources, select the desired resource, click the three-dot menu, and choose the item you would like to connect.

![Screenshot 2025-09-30 at 09.34.40](https://formalize.intercom-attachments.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/100962957/35bf1a5f95651459892182fae6db/Screenshot-202025-09-30-20at-2009_34_40.png?expires=1794341700&signature=dbd8b7853ac86e04c70f16be8edd71772ef67a7bb2b497f7ae19cacc4e574e4d&req=0dVvzF74pTIvlxv889osp2c8hh5wfs3keawFQn8lFxHpeO9cKT13zdHpsprQ%0AuObczTN%2Br81MJHcDQg%3D%3D%0A)

- **Use connections in numeric calculations**


You can use connections in your formulas for numeric calculations.

For example, in **Contracts** you may have a numeric field where you record the contract amount. In **Suppliers**, you may want to display the total value of all contracts linked to that supplier. By using connections in a formula, you can automatically calculate the sum of the amounts of all related contracts for each supplier.

​

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/132273880/84b2550572cb8012b23e22570632/CleanShot+2026-04-15+at+16_19_23%402x.png?expires=1794341700&signature=a0b4dac5adf10b6b17afae57b9a443c157dbd895cd4ba746e97e27595be3c77d&req=0dZtx1%2F5pD8olxv889osp0m2PXQB4tnLCnfQl5vbqc%2BnrJPygLMTKXY%2BSf3D%0A77wYRBbvl2BJUFbNMA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

# How to add a new connection

In order to add a new connection between two elements, you will have to proceed in 2 steps:

- First, go to **Settings** and chose the **Resource** you wish to use

- Scroll to the **Connections** section and create a new custom connection by clicking on the button " **\+ Create**".


![Capture d’écran 2025-09-23 à 10.43.21](https://formalize.intercom-attachments.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/100962960/9cb1a0b7dbb9c333e47a914b48d3/Capture-20d-E2-80-99-C3-A9cran-202025-09-23-20-C3-A0-2010_43_21.png?expires=1794341700&signature=27420c6f8c167047d17da88b4fc0850930f084f953f823784acd03e51255d988&req=0dVvzF74pTEolxv889osp5juzxxmthgtQveJuPAa9u1qI1mYcIjtmT%2Fy0JZf%0A38uGK6pjwS3d6l3Bdw%3D%3D%0A)

You will also be able to give the connection a **customized name**:

![Capture d’écran 2025-09-23 à 10.51.47](https://formalize.intercom-attachments.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/100962961/1ef53f79e8e525b4d27773ac98fc/Capture-20d-E2-80-99-C3-A9cran-202025-09-23-20-C3-A0-2010_51_47.png?expires=1794341700&signature=ba8546cac9dc0abd8ff8951d9197032eb77b81d60580452cc3914a28726089c9&req=0dVvzF74pTEplxv889osp%2FoYe3BwNpJrQRyvHRdqZzU%2B45J%2BYUc9GVKbAFG1%0AxGLAhzeGIvBg0RYeHA%3D%3D%0A)

You can also delete a connection you just created, if you decide it is no longer necessary. From **Settings**, select your **Resource** and then scroll down to the **Connections** section. Then click on **Edit** connection, and here you can customize the connection and give it a new name if you want to. To remove this, press **Delete** at the bottom of this view.

![Screenshot 2025-09-30 at 08.48.18](https://formalize.intercom-attachments.eu/i/o/t1sh39ul/100962963/83c673704d59b5b46b4d0dd1f86e/Screenshot-202025-09-30-20at-2008_48_18.png?expires=1794341700&signature=23b034d32e4875539d667ee67cab16b9781feea356ddb7318626db077752794a&req=0dVvzF74pTErlxv889osp9IG8rGZUJhY2pph3lVC0STFKxUe%2BXyorO33ceNV%0AorAC11CFDfyUw8YMGg%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

# Common questions

1. **Where do I find my connections now?**

You’ll find all connections in the Connections section of each Resource’s detail page. This is where both your existing and new connections are managed.

2. **Do I need to recreate my connections?**

No. All existing connections have been migrated automatically and are ready to use.
